content.sentence: At the beauty contest, the first runner-up was __________ than the winner.
It was __________ to cook once a week than to cook daily.
It was __________ to buy some groceries wholesale than in smaller quantities.
They wanted a __________ house than their current house.
The new technician was __________ than the previous one and could manage the repairs and office administration.
His new job at a high-rise building was __________ than the work he did before.
The practical examination was __________ than the theory exam.
The practical sessions were __________ than the theory classes.
The marketing team in her new job was __________ than the team she worked with before.
The design exhibition by the seniors this year was __________ than the exhibition held last year.

activity_b.text: At the beauty contest, the first runner-up was more beautiful than the winner.
It was more practical to cook once a week than to cook daily.
It was more economical to buy some groceries wholesale than in smaller quantities.
They wanted a more modern house than their current house.
The new technician was more efficient than the previous one and could manage the repairs and office administration.
His new job at a high-rise building was more dangerous than the work he did before.
The practical examination was more difficult than the theory exam.
The practical sessions were more interesting than the theory classes.
The marketing team in her new job was more professional than the team she worked with before.
The design exhibition by the seniors this year was more impressive than the exhibition held last year.

Why did Ashfaq prefer the metal clip remover?
What happened to two insulated spanners?
options: They were from the old batch.

Questions.question: Which diagnostic probe lead brand was more accurate?

activity_b.text: Good morning, sir. I’m checking the inventory list, especially the tools we used yesterday.
Yes, sir. We used the new torque multipliers, but one brand was stronger and more durable than the other.
We also need panel clip removers, but I think the metal version is sturdier than the plastic one.
Last week, the supplier said the new series was more reliable than the older batch.
The new series had a better grip, but the coating on two spanners was damaged.
Now, I’m going to prepare a new purchase order.
Order ten torque multipliers, maybe twelve insulated spanners because they are lighter and easier to handle, and order eight metal clip removers.
The instructor said the green brand was more accurate during voltage testing.
The green brand gave clearer readings.
The adjustable model is stronger and more practical than the fixed one.
Thank you, Ashfaq. You are getting better at identifying quality.
Thank you, sir. I enjoy learning about different tools.
